subject: the lost PO-02 Code-2 packaging return
why_it_can_never_be_completed: a provider-reported completion carries no durable result commit. Obzio COMPLETED requires PARENT_INGESTED, PARENT_INGESTED requires an ingested result, and ingestion requires every artifact to read back from an immutable Git object. With durable_result_commit_id null and durable_artifacts empty there is nothing to read back, so no path to COMPLETED exists.
recovery_route_without_founder_relay: rerun the unit from its immutable input capsule, which is durable in the repository; no founder message, memory export or relay is an input to that decision

state_reconciliation.note: the recorded evidence names the four routes as founder-reported. The fixture label drops that qualifier. Both assert the same fact: four reported routes, no recovered result. The producer records both labels verbatim rather than silently rewriting either.

NOT_TESTED is the recorded acceptance state; NOT_ACCEPTED is the commissioned fixture state. NOT_TESTED implies NOT_ACCEPTED, so the fixture value is consistent with the evidence and strictly weaker in what it claims about review. The producer records both and does not upgrade either.

causal_defects_recorded_by_the_evidence: task schema allowed completed with null result and empty artifacts

scale increased without proportional recovery and acceptance capacity

the seeded contract forces such a document to obzio_state PROVIDER_COMPLETED_UNCOMMITTED
